definitions.full: H6830. tsephoni II. צְפוֺנִי adjective from foregoing, northern (so most); — with article as noun masculine northern one, northerner, invader from north Joel 2:20 (of locust-swarm, compare We Now Dr, GASm Proph. ii. 397 ). — I. צְפוֺנִי see צִפְיוֺן below I. צמה .
